about: Six public-domain (CC0) music beds, 43 to 54 s each, cut on a bar start with a fade-out, with a beat grid beside each (<name>.beats.json) for cutting a film to the beat.

sounds.name: Calm lo-fi bed
sounds.use_for: Quiet explainers, onboarding and how-to films where the voice leads.
sounds.author: Loyalty Freak Music (Monplaisir)
sounds.original: Lack of Color - I'm glad you are here with me (album: LOFI AMBIENT SONGS !)

evidence.creator: Loyalty Freak Music
evidence.vocals_check: earshot match: 'singing vocals' gave no match

sounds.edit: cut on a bar start from the original, 2 s fade-out, levelled to -1 dBFS peak, 48 kHz stereo MP3 (level.py make --peak -1)
